| `content`    | `object`             |          | `\{\}`  | The widget configuration. - `field` (required) — the object field holding the array. - `key` — the item field that identifies an entry (default: the item itself for strings). - `row` — `{ title, titleFallback?, avatar?, meta?: [paths\|{ path, map?, format? }], pill?: { path, map?, variantMap? }, aside?: { path, format?, prefix?, fallback? }, detail?: { template, when?, copy?: [{ path, label }] } }`. `detail.copy` puts a copy button beside the detail line for each named value of the row (an empty value gets none), such as a DNS record's name and value. - `add` — `{ label?, fields: [{ key, label, type?: 'text'\|'select', options?, required?, pattern?, patternMessage? }], unique?, defaults? }`. - `remove` — `{ label? }`; omitted = no remove. - `rowActions` — `[{ id, label, ariaLabel?, when?, placement?: 'band'\|'inline', request: { method?, url, payload? } }]`, or `{ id, label, dialog, props }` to open a modal registered in the app registry with filled props (shown in `readOnly` too, since it writes nothing, and only when every token in `props` fills); tokens `@object.&lt;field&gt;`, `@objectId`, `@row.&lt;field&gt;`, `@index`. In the table variant `placement: 'inline'` draws the action as a button in the row instead of in the "..." menu; `ariaLabel` is a template filled from the row. - `when` (row actions, `detail`) — `{ field: value }`, every field equal; or per field `{ eq?, neq?, set? }`, where a value `@row.&lt;field&gt;` (or `@&lt;field&gt;`) is another field of the same row: `{ deliveredRef: { set: true, neq: '@originalRef' } }`. - `rowSource` — `{ url, path?, key }`: live per-row state merged by key. - `variant: 'table'` + `columns` — `[{ header, path, map?, format?, strong?, pill?, variantMap? }]`: rows as a table; a per-row "..." menu holds the row actions and remove; `detail` lines become a warning band under the table, with the row actions that have `placement: 'band'`. - `add.trigger: 'button'`, `add.placement: 'header' \| 'footer'` — the add form opens from a button. - `readOnly`, `hint`, `emptyText`. - `row.href` — the path of a link for the row title; only http(s) and root-relative links, an absolute one opens in a new tab. - `lead` — a line above the rows, translated, with `{path}` filled from the object. - `edit` — `true` or `{ label?, saveLabel? }`: an Edit button per row opens the form prefilled and saves the entry in place. - `add.fields[].type: 'checkbox'`; `add.exclusive` — flags only one entry holds; `add.requireOneOf` (+ `requireOneOfMessage`) — keys of which one must be filled. - `row.href` may be `{ path, scheme: 'mailto'\|'tel' }`. - `afterSave` — `{ url, method?, body?, failureText? }`: called after every save that went through, with `@objectId` / `@object.&lt;field&gt;` tokens; when it fails the save stands and `failureText` shows. |
